newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian money market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian money market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Indonesian money market was closed on Thursday for a public holiday to observe the birth of the Prophet Muhammad.
The rupiah tumbled against the dollar in late trading on Wednesday after operators moved to cover stop-loss and short positions ahead of the holiday.
Dealers said the stop-loss selling sent the rupiah nosediving to 2,470 in the late afternoon before it later recovered to 2,476.
The market resumes trading on Friday.
